cases.title: Prior daily close retains its own availability and age
minimal_events: Previous daily bar D0 ends at clock 100 with close 1000; required watermark arrives 102; observation first received 103. Intraday decisions occur at 101, 103, and 104.
D1 is still forming; a later final close 1200 becomes known at 203. A fill-forward D0 copy is attached to the intraday row at 104.
expected_semantics: At 101 D0 is not yet admissible under this received-mode fixture. At 103 use D0=1000 with source interval end 100 and known clock 103.

At 104 reuse D0 content without advancing its economic observation clock. D1 final=1200 cannot appear at D1 open or earlier cuts. Distinguish close[1] with lookahead from unshifted future-completed HTF content.
remaining_gates: Declare historical publication/receipt model and daily calendar; selected Pine code alone does not certify real historical availability.
Require F04/F06 clock and fill-forward consumer integration; annualization and probabilistic claims remain outside F09.

cases.title: Coarse bar straddling IB end cannot allocate final extrema
minimal_events: IB is [09:30,10:30). The chart bar [10:25,10:35) has O=100,H=110,L=90,C=105 and no lower-timeframe observations.
Alternative complete ordered events have 10:29 price101, 10:30 price110, 10:34 price90, and known times equal event times; earlier IB range is [99,103].
expected_semantics: Coarse OHLC alone cannot assign H=110 or L=90 to the IB; emit unsupported/incomplete boundary-dependent extrema, not a fabricated split.

With complete ordered events the exact 10:30 event belongs to the next half-open interval. IB stays [99,103]; post-IB includes 110 and 90. A final chart bar published 10:35 cannot have supplied a final IB result at 10:30.
remaining_gates: Register calendar/timezone and watermark plus positive coverage for the full IB.

cases.title: Same-subbar extrema preserve unresolved first-touch order
minimal_events: A completed lower-timeframe bar has O=100,H=110,L=90,C=101 and contains both final IB extremes. Its internal trade order is absent.
Alternative raw paths A=100,110,90,101 and B=100,90,110,101 have identical OHLC. A separate fixture contains no valid extrema observations.
expected_semantics: OHLC agrees for A/B but high-first differs. Shared summary must not claim observed first-touch order from OHLC; retain ambiguity or ordered event evidence.
Literal Pine high-on-tie rule can be recorded as a named heuristic, separate from observed order. Missing extrema remain unknown and must not become boolean false selecting a low-first table.
remaining_gates: Need registered order-evidence capability and tie policy; quote/trade and same-timestamp order remain distinct.

cases.title: Covered no-break, pending and missing session are distinct
minimal_events: IB final range [90,110]; post-IB opportunity [10,20). All observed prices are 100.
Run A supplies positive complete coverage [10,20). Run B has a gap [14,16). Run C stops at cut18. Run D has no trades but certified complete healthy observation for [10,20).
expected_semantics: A at20 can label neither strict break. B cannot label neither; gap leaves unknown outcome even if visible bars never break. C remains pending.
D has a covered empty trade interval: zero observed trade volume, no fabricated traded OHLC; no-break label requires a separately declared observation process sufficient for that target.
Repeated end-of-session evaluation increments a completed-session denominator at most once.
remaining_gates: Specify whether no-break is defined on trades or quotes and exactly what coverage proves opportunity.
F06 positive coverage, F03 session finalization, and downstream denominator integration remain required.

cases.title: Midpoint interval contact differs from endpoint-near heuristic
minimal_events: Frozen midpoint M=100; a prior bar established a leave. Next final bar has low98, high102 and close101; tolerance is0.1% of M=0.1.
Alternative bar is entirely above midpoint with low100.05 high101; another is [100.2,101].
expected_semantics: Wide bar [98,102] contains M but neither endpoint is within0.1: interval-contact=true and endpoint-near=false. Do not substitute one definition for the other.
[100.05,101] has endpoint-near=true but does not cross M; [100.2,101] has neither. An OHLC contact supports existence within the observed interval, not the exact first-touch timestamp or order.
No bar-completion-dependent contact may be emitted before final bar availability unless explicitly provisional. Drawing/reference time must remain distinct.
remaining_gates: Register literal endpoint-near versus corrected interval-contact variant, leave predicate, strictness and one-time transition.
This is a consumer geometry guard using common bars; no F09 claim of probability, execution or full PIN030 closure.
